coordinate_frame: glTF world +Y up, +Z character front. Back-view image left corresponds to world positiveX. Source local root is 180deg aroundY.

registration.uncertainty: About4-6pixels/.01-.015world. Manual crown/sole registration, not a solved camera or exact anatomy.

reference_observations: Back shows about5-7 dominant broad flattened S locks with staggered tapered ends. Finer flyaways exist but are not the dominant lower hair form.
Profiles show fall behind the earcup, outward middle wave, then inward lower return; six-view atlas supplies both visible profile silhouettes.
Current model remains a broad merged lower bulb despite painted curls. Appending curves alone cannot remove that source base or create all reference valleys.

safe_first_scope.location: Rear/lower hair, no front bangs/crown/headphones/face or body edits. Preserve existing source scene nodes, geometry/accessors, images and BIN bytes.
safe_first_scope.shape: Flattened lenticular closed ribbon with smooth broad S centerline and tapered tip. Width/thickness are inferred pilot values, not calibrated exact measurements.
safe_first_scope.terminal_Z_caution: Curl return toward-.15 may bury into the existing source hair; actual attachment/contact and occlusion must be checked, not guessed as approved.
avoid: 4-6 thin round noodle tubes in first pilot.
Duplicating reference-painted curls with dense raised overlays across front/shoulders.
Another uniform bulk expansion, a larger lower balloon, or uniform end shortening.
Pretending additive locks erase original merged surface or establish perfect hair fidelity.

review_requirements: Actual same-camera front/back/both profiles andthree-quarter, plus gray/clay geometry views to distinguish 3D silhouette from painted highlights.
Reject clear front silhouette/face/headphone regression, conspicuous floating or detached crescent tips, extra lower balloon or hair covering preserved hands/body.
Byte proof for untouched source and appended-only meshes, complete closed-cap/finite-normal/winding tests, and explicit attachment/contact limitations.
Document colors sampled from unchanged references as baked shading, not new bitmap textures or verified physical relighting.
remaining_inference: Hidden strand joins/scalp attachment and thickness are not fully specified by the provided views.
Reference poses/proportions differ slightly, so matching every projected pixel simultaneously is not assumed.
Closed mesh tests do not themselves prove collision-free attachment or visual approval.
